method: Chromium SwiftShader software, 640×420 DPR1; twelve hot synchronized renders per version/cell, gl.finish + readPixels; alternating order. Same camera, date, weather and M11 updates. Static map and all LOD transitions stabilized; forty matched virtual M11 seconds after streaming warm-up, never a native walking sequence. No other graphical test running. Not Android/GPU hardware FPS.
